title: Build a Do-It-Yourself Air Purifier for About $40
summary: A University of Michigan Medicine demonstration of building a cheap DIY air purifier from a box fan and a HEPA or high-MERV filter using hardware-store parts. It explains why this helps against dust, smoke and viruses and ties it to local air quality readings.
why: HN people link it during wildfire smoke and air quality threads as a practical, cheap fix, though a few doubt how rigorously its effectiveness was shown.

quote.text: Here's a video from the University of Michigan showing just how effective these cheap DIY air filters can be
